rows.title: Vengeance Is Mine 2005, directed by Shohei Imamura | Film review
rows.comment: Imamura’s often brilliant tale of Eros and Thanatos is <strong>perverse
rows.verdict_le10: Imamura’s often brilliant tale of Eros and Thanatos is <strong>perverse
rows.dek_lead: Are compromise, oppression, madness, violence and a death wish par for the Japanese course? At once darkly comic and quasi-tragic, Imamura’s often brilliant tale of Eros and Thanatos is perverse, powerful and subversive.
